static_inspection_findings.evidence: UserExperienceStore exposes command/attention operations only; it has no durable admission-record write/read contract.

ExperienceAdmission binds workId, principal/session, capability, descriptor/digests, route digest, action/effect and evidence ref, but not workVersion. submit compares command workVersion to a separately supplied authoritativeWorkVersion, permitting no persisted proof that the admission itself was version-bound.
UserInteractionCommand persists admissionRef but the current store contract has no way to resolve that ref to the immutable admission bindings for independent reconstruction.
The bounded patch contains no JDBC/SQL/database migration surface for the new admission fields.
The exact 435-file capsule is referenced by digest but is not committed as runnable source on the Core ref.

required_tests.expectation: Persist and reconstruct every admission field byte-for-byte, including workId/workVersion, capability, requirement digest, descriptor identity/digest, route digest, caller, principal/session, action/effect, authority grants/evidence and admission evidence ref.
Command admissionRef resolves to exactly one immutable admission record and fails closed for zero or multiple matches.
Each required admission field omitted independently is rejected before command persistence and effect dispatch.
Mutations to work id/version, capability, requirement digest, descriptor identity/digest, route digest, caller, principal/session, action/effect, authority or evidence ref each fail.
A command with a valid admissionRef but mismatched payload/work/action identity fails with zero writes.
Legacy record lacking immutable bindings becomes explicitly MIGRATED_UNQUALIFIED or is rejected; never admitted silently.
Migration output is deterministic, digest-bound, idempotent and evidence-bearing.
Same command and idempotency key returns the same durable record without another write.
Same idempotency key with different work/version/admission/action/payload conflicts.
Competing admissions for one governed work identity cannot both become current.
Optimistic-version conflict preserves both evidence records and a deterministic winner/loser disposition.
Crash after validation but before commit yields zero durable command/admission mutation.
Crash after durable commit but before acknowledgement is recoverable by idempotent replay.
Partial/corrupt admission record fails reconstruction and cannot authorize an effect.
Transaction rollback leaves zero command writes and zero effect receipts.
UX and persistence adapter cannot mint caller/effect authority or execute effects.
Approval actions without approvalRef fail with zero durable mutation.
PENDING/unqualified descriptor and missing authority grant fail.
Fresh exact-capsule extraction recomputes the declared 435-file source/test digest before compilation.
Strict Java 21 and all 21 inherited suites plus persistence-focused suites run without hidden machine state.
Source/test digest, release manifest, current-authority record, migration, schema, database contract and qualification receipt identify one exact candidate.
Portable/hosted results do not set A-01, native/device, human, promotion or production authority.

execution_plan: Acquire exact capsule bytes and verify size plus SHA-256 before extraction.
Recompute the source/test identity using the governing canonical file-order algorithm; require fe325804... before any unchanged-candidate claim.

Run strict Java 21 compilation, 21 inherited suites, all required focused cases above, static schema/SQL parity, release-manifest and fresh-extraction checks.
Publish exact logs/digests and a GitHub-native source-custody manifest; hosted/A-01 remain later independent gates.

current_stop.details: CORE can specify and test the cross-boundary contract but cannot invent the DATA-owned adapter/migration. The exact capsule is not present in the GitHub tree, and remote byte materialization returned a transient 502 in this run; therefore runtime PASS is not claimed.
